# FFmpeg source availability and packaging scope

This package contains the original, unmodified GPLv3 FFmpeg and FFprobe executables from Gyan's 9.0.1 essentials Windows x64 build. The accompanying LICENSE.txt is byte-identical to the upstream license. README.gyan.txt preserves the original upstream build configuration and dependency version list.

Upstream binary archive:
https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/download/9.0.1/ffmpeg-9.0.1-essentials_build.7z

Archive SHA-256:
49a73bdf0850092a252ac4641d922f3048d63ed113e196cc65ce1e4f7fb33e85

FFmpeg core source commit declared by the supplier:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa

The source commit link covers FFmpeg core. It is not a claim that all corresponding source, dependency revisions, patches, and build instructions for these static binaries have been collected or provided. Some dependency revisions and transitive build inputs remain unverified.

Technical packaging approval permits local Publish and installation testing with the reviewed files. The following states remain explicit:

- approvalKind: TechnicalPackaging
- correspondingSourceComplete: false
- redistributionQualified: false
- productionQualified: false

No complete-source availability promise or written source offer is being made by this document. Source provision and redistribution qualification must be resolved and verified before claiming that customer distribution has been qualified. This document does not change the upstream license or claim ownership over FFmpeg.
